post_wise_breakdown.monthly_emoluments: a) Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for candidates qualified in CSIR-UGC / ICAR / ICMR NET lectureship / Assistant professorship or GATE, or National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/DST or equivalent and/or their Agencies/Institutions.b) Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others not falling under (a) above.

selection_process: Selection will be done on the basis of a Walk-in-Interview at CSIR-NEERI
how_to_apply: Download and fill out the application form attached to the official notification from the website www.neeri.res.in.
Ensure you meet all essential qualifications and possess a declared result (with at least a provisional certificate).
Prepare a passport-size photograph, your Aadhaar card, 10th (SSC), 12th (HSC), and Graduate mark sheets and degrees.
Keep one set of photocopies and the original certificates ready.
Attend the walk-in-interview at CSIR-NEERI, Nehru Marg, Near Ajni Square, Nagpur - 440020 on 16 October 2026.
Report between 9:30 am and 11:00 am (note that the gate will be closed by 11:00 am).
important_instructions: The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project "Fly Ash Leachability Studies at Ash Filling sites of Adani Power Limited (APL), Tiroda - (CNP-3008)". Engagement does not confer any right implicit or explicit for regularization against any CSIR/CSIR-NEERI post. The tenure of project staff who have served CSIR-NEERI or any other CSIR laboratories under contract R&D projects cannot exceed six or seven years as per CSIR OM No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD Dated 02.09.2024. Candidates must have acquired essential qualifications and results must be declared (at least provisional certificate) before applying; final semester/result-awaited candidates are not allowed. No TA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Selected candidates must make their own accommodation arrangements, though HRA is admissible as per rules. Selected candidates must sign an undertaking for maintaining the confidentiality of project findings and intellectual property information.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the recruitment?
faq.answer: CSIR National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-NEERI), Nagpur is conducting the recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name is Project Associate-I (PAT-I).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 advertised vacancy, with an anticipated vacancy of up to 2 posts depending upon the availability of funds.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in-interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in-interview will be held on 16 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the reporting time for the interview?
faq.answer: Reporting time is from 9:30 am to 11:00 am, and the gate will be closed by 11:00 am.

faq.question: Q6. What is the essential qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Geology or Applied Geology from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, candidates are not required to pay any application fees.

faq.question: Q9. What are the monthly emoluments?
faq.answer: Emoluments are Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for NET/GATE qualified candidates, and Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at CSIR-NEERI, Nehru Marg, Near Ajni Square, Nagpur - 440020.
